test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) FK-IN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cf6839c04f89299548ef9ee44e8cebd9a2330b7a671553e4878b1d9d3128ad6.png] 

Option 2) DI-GL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18dd15d51a7d899c0d2f93ede1880a538af8fd30e1c0767916b2e8bc412efd77.png] 

Option 3) LP-NR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b1be8d89dfc1e415bd1c6c187d4cc86190c0fe134fbad7e000fb9b6d1fc9483.png] 

Option 4) QV-TY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c45bed80b226eac5e7d1d5217791c54d17bfa0a1161a3f75f6e70734937aa076.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'LP-NR' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
